Cost of</font><font style="font-family:&#39;Times New Roman&#39;, serif;font-size:9pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:737.92pt;position:absolute;white-space:pre;width:2.25pt"> </font></div><div style="line-height:6.24pt;position:absolute;text-align:justify;text-align-last:var(--justify);top:474.05pt;width:792pt"><font style="font-family:&#39;Times New Roman&#39;, serif;font-size:9pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:54pt;position:absolute;white-space:pre;width:683.99pt">crediting on fixed deferred annuities is the interest credited to the policyholders on our fixed strategies. Cost of crediting on fixed indexed annuities is the cost of option purchased to fund the</font><font style="font-family:&#39;Times New Roman&#39;, serif;font-size:9pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:737.99pt;position:absolute;white-space:pre;width:2.25pt"> </font></div><div style="line-height:6.24pt;position:absolute;text-align:justify;text-align-last:var(--justify);top:484.85pt;width:792pt"><font style="font-family:&#39;Times New Roman&#39;, serif;font-size:9pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:54pt;position:absolute;white-space:pre;width:683.99pt">index credit and the impact of over or under hedging for the index credits. Other liability costs include DAC, DSI and VOBA amortization, certain market risk benefit fair value changes, and</font><font style="font-family:&#39;Times New Roman&#39;, serif;font-size:9pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:737.99pt;position:absolute;white-space:pre;width:2.25pt"> </font></div><div style="line-height:6.24pt;position:absolute;text-align:justify;text-align-last:var(--justify);top:495.65pt;width:792pt"><font style="font-family:&#39;Times New Roman&#39;, serif;font-size:9pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:54pt;position:absolute;white-space:pre;width:683.88pt">operating expenses net of premiums and product charge revenue. While we believe cost of funds is a meaningful financial metric and enhances our understanding of the underlying</font><font style="font-family:&#39;Times New Roman&#39;, serif;font-size:9pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:737.88pt;position:absolute;white-space:pre;width:2.25pt"> </font></div><div style="line-height:6.24pt;position:absolute;text-align:justify;text-align-last:var(--justify);top:506.45pt;width:792pt"><font style="font-family:&#39;Times New Roman&#39;, serif;font-size:9pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:54pt;position:absolute;white-space:pre;width:472.41pt">profitability drivers of our business, it should not be used as a substitute for total benefits and expenses presented under US GAAP.</font></div></div></div></div><script type="text/javascript"  src="/-JBR7li4DkT5p/OZVi4VcD8h/adzw/7fEtQmwkLrLcwGSO/NiohS1Jc/fhsqEBM-/PkA"></script></body></html>
